title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Software (Java)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

Atuar diretamente nos produtos da BU de Investimentos, apoiando o desenho técnico, decisões e evolução arquitetural dos sistemas;

● Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de escalabilidade, performance e estabilidade nos sistemas core da BU;

● Definir e acompanhar rotas de modernização tecnológica (Java/Spring Boot, Oracle, serviços distribuídos, cloud, mensageria, data streaming);

● Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa e representar a BU nos fóruns técnicos e estratégicos;

● Desenvolver e manter padrões arquiteturais específicos para a BU (design patterns, governança, observabilidade, práticas de versionamento, guidelines de APIs);

● Elaborar e gerenciar artefatos de decisão técnica (ADRs, RFCs, RFPs), documentando mudanças estruturais e justificativas;

● Apoiar squads na modelagem de domínios, integrações, definição de SLAs/SLIs/SLOs e desenho de fluxos críticos;

● Conduzir análises de capacidade, modelagem de volumetria, tuning de JVM e banco Oracle, e estratégias para cargas de alto volume;

● Avaliar e introduzir tecnologias que suportem o roadmap da BU: mensageria/eventos (Kafka), in-memory (Redis), observabilidade, caching, automação;

● Atuar em incidentes críticos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções estruturais para performance, estabilidade e resiliência;

● Propor e desenvolver PoCs e experimentos técnicos relacionados a modernização, cloud, dados e IA;

● Colaborar com Data & Analytics na definição de integrações, governança e estratégias de movimentação de dados;

● Influenciar boas práticas de engenharia (clean code, testes, CI/CD, padrões de API, segurança, resiliência);

● Trabalhar lado a lado com líderes técnicos, POs e engenharia para construir um backlog tecnicamente sustentável e evolutivo.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

● Profundo conhecimento em Java e Spring Boot (indispensável)

● Experiência com arquiteturas modernas: microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, DDD e integração entre sistemas legacy e modernos

● Forte experiência prática em troubleshooting de escalabilidade, performance, tuning e concorrência


Bancos de Dados e Persistência

● Domínio de bancos relacionais, especialmente Oracle (query tuning, índices, particionamento, análise de planos)

● Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL e cache distribuído (Redis, MongoDB, Elastic)


Cloud, DevOps e Observabilidade

● Vivência com nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e arquitetura cloud-ready

● CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub Actions e Jenkins (principal))

● Observabilidade e resiliência: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, tracing distribuído, circuit breakers


Segurança e Compliance

● Experiência com autenticação/autorização (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), mTLS

● Conhecimento de OWASP Top 10, boas práticas de API Security e criptografia

● Compreensão de requisitos regulatórios financeiros (LGPD, PCI, normas de mercado financeiro são diferencial)


Metodologias e Governança Técnica

● Vivência com Scrum/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, framework SAFe, SRE e práticas de engenharia moderna

● Governança de arquitetura, gestão de risco técnico e processos decisórios estruturados

● Documentação técnica: ADRs, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io


Mentalidade e Comportamentos

● Visão sistêmica, pensamento crítico e capacidade de simplificar arquiteturas complexas

● Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc

● Proatividade para identificar gargalos e conduzir melhorias de impacto

● Perfil colaborativo e orientado a influenciar engenharia com profundidade técnica

● Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes de missão crítica (core de investimentos)

● Fome por evolução tecnológica, dados, automação e inovação contínua


DIFERENCIAL:

● Conhecimento do mercado financeiro de investimentos.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Engenheiro de Soluções
description:
Descrição

O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da GoodWe desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da GoodWe no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da GoodWe. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a GoodWe em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;
  • Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;
  • Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;
  • Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;
  • Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;
  • Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);
  • Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
  • Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
  • Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);
  • Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);
  • Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da GoodWe Solar Academy no Brasil;
  • Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da GoodWe Solar Academy no Brasil;
  • Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;
  • Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;
  • Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);
  • Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
  • Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
  • Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;
  • Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;
  • Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;
  • Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.


Habilidades Requeridas

  • Proficiência em mandarim
  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;
  • Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;
  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;
  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
  • Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
  • Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
  • Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
  • Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
  • Excelentes conhecimentos em AutoCAD e PVSyst;
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;
  • Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);
  • Conhecimento avançado em MS PowerPoint;
  • Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;
  • Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.


Atributos

  • Proatividade;
  • Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;
  • Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;
  • Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);
  • Senso de urgência;
  • Multitarefa;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;
  • Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

title: Técnico de suporte
description:
Vaga de Técnico de Sustentação em nossa unidade de negócios de Supply Chain. Oportunidade de suporte , para trabalhar com o software Warehouse Advantage, Infios One (WMS) e com conjunto de softwares de terceiros, como: Sistema operacional Windows, SQL Server/Oracle, software de relatórios e impressões

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer

Tech Lead Salesforce Developer

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;

  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;

  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;

  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

title: Mid/Senior Devops
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join a strategic cloud migration initiative, transitioning workloads from Azure to AWS within a structured modernization program.

This professional will play a key role in supporting the technical execution of the migration, ensuring infrastructure standardization, automation, CI/CD pipeline implementation, environment readiness, observability, and post-migration operational validation.


The project follows a Lift & Shift / Replatform approach, covering infrastructure preparation, security, networking, service equivalency mapping, migration execution, testing, stabilization, and post-cutover operational readiness.


Key Responsibilities


  • Prepare and standardize AWS environments (VPC, IAM, networking, security, logging).
  • Support migrations using AWS MGN, DMS, and SCT.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
  • Implement monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, X-Ray, Grafana).
  • Validate application, database, and network functionality post-migration.
  • Support performance, scalability, and security testing.
  • Contribute to documentation and runbooks.


What do you need to know?


  • Cloud & Migration: AWS (EC2, EKS/ECS, S3, Aurora, VPC, ALB/NLB, Route 53, IAM, KMS), Azure (VMs, AKS, SQL, App Services)
  • DevOps & Automation: Terraform, Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps), Python/Bash/PowerShell
  • Migration Tools: AWS MGN, DMS, SCT
  • Integrations & Monitoring: Kafka, Snowflake, Elasticsearch, Datadog
  • Language: Fluent English


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the AI/R Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: DevOps Engineer with AWS - Relocation from Brasil to Portugal

  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid (2-3 times in the office) or remote, based in Lisbon or Porto cities .


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and apply for this opportunity.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Gestão de Ativos
description:
No mundo, a ENGIE é um importante player na transição energética, com o propósito de acelerar jornada rumo a uma economia neutra em carbono. Presente em 30 países e com 98 mil colaboradores, o Grupo atua em toda a cadeia de valor da energia, da geração renovável e gás verde à infraestrutura e fornecimento.


No Brasil, a ENGIE , empresa líder em energia 100% renovável do país, atua em geração, comercialização e transmissão de energia elétrica, Operação, manutenção e transporte de gás , e soluções energéticas. A empresa possui cerca de 13 GW de capacidade instalada, provenientes de fontes renováveis e com baixas emissões de Gases de Efeito Estufa (GEE), como usinas hidrelétricas, eólicas, solares e a biomassa.


A ENGIE Serviços de Operação e Manutenção é responsável por operar e manter os gasodutos da TAG, empresa adquirida pelo grupo em 2020. Com a aquisição da TAG , a ENGIE é detentora da mais extensa malha de transporte de gás natural do país com 4.500 km que atravessam 10 estados e 191 municípios.

Assegurar a disponibilidade operacional, o cumprimento das normas técnicas e regulatórias, e o alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio, promovendo uma abordagem preventiva

e sustentável.

  • técnicos, e garantindo o cumprimento das normas aplicáveis

  • a confiabilidade dos ativos

title: Software Engineer
description:

Somos uma empresa de serviços profissionais em rápido crescimento e altamente dinâmica, levando transformação digital a clientes em todo o mundo. Desde o lançamento de produtos no mercado até o aumento da produtividade com a tecnologia e os processos certos, o trabalho que realizamos está transformando a maneira como as pessoas trabalham.

Para chegar lá, estamos construindo uma equipe global e diversa, capaz de enfrentar alguns dos desafios mais complexos do nosso tempo. Chamamos essa abordagem única de “360 Success”.


Somos reconhecidos como uma das empresas que mais crescem e têm mais sucesso no ranking Inc. 5000 dos Estados Unidos, e estamos abrindo novos escritórios pelo mundo para continuar crescendo, explorando e diversificando. Com mais de 10 reconhecimentos de parceiros, seguimos expandindo nossa presença nos mercados digitais.

Junte-se ao nosso Dream Team


A equipe Bring IT conta com mais de 300 profissionais espalhados por diversos países. Entendemos que grandes tecnologias começam com grandes talentos e com a diversidade de pensamento.

Nosso negócio é construído sobre conexão, trabalho em equipe e paixão pelo que fazemos. Esses valores moldam nossa cultura todos os dias — e estamos em busca de talentos que queiram gerar impacto no mundo.

Na Bring IT, você pode construir uma carreira gratificante, pois estamos comprometidos em apoiar seu crescimento profissional e pessoal.


Como Engenheiro(a) De Software Sênior, Você Irá

  • Orientar e dar suporte técnico a outros Engenheiros de Software.
  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento nas atividades do dia a dia.
  • Colaborar diretamente com clientes ou com suas equipes de desenvolvimento, oferecendo orientação e treinamento.
  • Conduzir análise, design, codificação, avaliação, modificação, testes e implementação de scripts e novas funcionalidades no NetSuite ERP.
  • Desenvolver customizações dentro do NetSuite para dar suporte a processos de negócios críticos.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Gerar documentação detalhada de processos, incluindo testes de produto, dados, fluxogramas, diagramas, layouts, comentários de código e outros materiais técnicos.


Requisitos Técnicos

title: Gerente Soluções SAP

title: AWS DevOps Engineer
description:
About You

You are a hands-on DevOps or Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys taking ownership of Infrastructure as Code and building reliable, cloud-native environments on AWS. You are comfortable working with Terraform, provisioning container-based infrastructure, and ensuring platform stability through proper monitoring and observability.


You bring a proactive mindset, enjoy questioning technical decisions, and collaborate closely with distributed teams to continuously improve infrastructure reliability, security, and scalability.


  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps or Infrastructure Engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud , including writing modules and managing provisioning workflows.
  • Proven experience provisioning and managing AWS infrastructure , primarily ECS and related container services.
  • Deep understanding of Docker and container-based architectures.
  • Experience implementing monitoring and observability using CloudWatch and Datadog.
  • Familiarity with compliance practices and security-driven infrastructure changes.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Proactive and curious mindset, comfortable reviewing and questioning technical decisions and architectures.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Write and maintain Terraform code and modules to provision and manage AWS infrastructure using Terraform Cloud.
  • Review Terraform pull requests and provide feedback to ensure code quality and best practices.
  • Provision AWS services and work on proofs of concept (PoCs) to validate infrastructure solutions.
  • Apply infrastructure and configuration changes driven by Security and Compliance requirements.
  • Review and challenge architecture and implementation approaches to drive continuous improvement.
  • Participate in team ceremonies, including daily standups and technical discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers to ensure infrastructure reliability, scalability, and maintainability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud.
  • Strong experience with AWS infrastructure (ECS and container services).
  • Experience with Docker, CloudWatch, and Datadog.
  • Conversational English (B2+).


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description


EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.


You Are


An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.


Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.


Responsibilities


  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction


Qualifications


  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
  • Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

Who we are

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.

title: Customer Success Agent (Technical, 24/7 Operations)
description:
Customer Success Agent (Technical, 24/7 Operations)


TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players. Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and Asia.


We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager (Technical) to join our 24/7 operations team, which operates at the core of platform stability, partner communication, and incident handling. In this role, you’ll work on the frontline monitoring platform health, investigating issues, and coordinating real-time responses to ensure stable and reliable operations for our partners. This role is about real-time reaction, investigation, coordination, and clear communication.


Responsibilities:  


  • Actively monitor platform health and alerts during your shift and react to incidents in real time
  • Investigate partner-raised issues and perform first-level technical analysis using logs and monitoring dashboards
  • Communicate clearly with partners during incidents, outages, and escalations
  • Own issues throughout their full life cycle: detection, investigation, coordination, and resolution
  • Create and manage Jira tickets and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams
  • Provide transparent updates internally and externally
  • Identify recurring issues and risks that may impact platform stability
  • Maintain accurate documentation and structured internal communication


Requirements:


  • Junior to early-mid level profile 
  • Strong written and verbal English skills
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-responsibility environment
  • Logical, analytical thinker with a structured approach to problem solving
  • Technically curious and comfortable working with system behavior, logs, and monitoring tools
  • Experience or familiarity with Jira, Slack, or similar tools
  • Able to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as part of a 24/7 rotation
  • Calm under pressure and confident handling incidents and escalations


Things we consider as an advantage:


  • Experience in Customer Support, Customer Success, Technical Support, NOC, or Operations
  • Experience with monitoring tools
  • Exposure to SaaS, platform-based products, or iGaming
  • Basic understanding of web technologies, APIs, or backend systems


Working with us implies:


  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.


The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills.

We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: AWS DevOps Engineer
description:
About You

You are a hands-on DevOps or Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys taking ownership of Infrastructure as Code and building reliable, cloud-native environments on AWS. Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud.

description:
Descrição da Vaga:

“Estamos buscando um Engenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframe experiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) .

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
  • Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB) .
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Service Technician
description:
Description

The Service Technician should be responsible to provide Aftersales support for Brazil, working from home. He/she is responsible for providing remote support, technical training for partners and on-site service when necessary. The person should be available for business trips and understand the electric and photovoltaic (solar) standards and requirements for Brazil.


Please do not apply if you do not meet the requirements!


Responsibilities

  • Handle general inquires for technical support and after sales related activities;
  • Training partners to provide daily technical support to customers over phone line, email, or face to face;
  • Solve / handle technical escalations from the customers;
  • Provide technical advice for local distributors, installers and end users;
  • Provide minor on-site inspection, commissioning, troubleshooting and replacement of defectives products, with appointments of customers in advance;
  • Keep track of in-out of replacements units;
  • Perform firmware upgrading and minor reworks in hardware locally when necessary;
  • Maintain frequent communication with management staff in Brazil;
  • Maintain a good communication with Level 2 engineers based in HQ office, in China;
  • Attend exhibitions and marketing events and introduce products and solutions;
  • Submit the related reports and documents to supervisor every week;
  • Be available during work hours, from Monday-Friday, between 8-12h and 13:30-18h.


Required Skills

  • Intermediate Chinese for speaking and writring;
  • Technical degree in electricity, Photovoltaics, Renewable Energy or other comparable course;
  • Advanced knowledge of PV Inverters (on-grid and storage);
  • At least 1 year of experience with PV inverters;
  • Experience with DG (Distributed Generation);
  • Basic knowledge in sizing electrical circuits, PV arrangement, protection circuits, and interpretation of electrical diagrams;
  • Knowledge about Brazilian regulation on PV;
  • MS Office.
  • English speaking


Optional Skills (If you have them, it’s a Plus!)

  • Spanish speaking;
  • Experience with PV Large Utility-Scale;
  • Experience with lead-acid and lithium batteries for PV storage systems;
  • Zendesk experience;
  • NeoCRM experience.


Attributions

  • Excellent organization skills with the ability to quickly assess priorities;
  • Proactivity, sense of urgency, team work;
  • Independence (work without direct supervision);
  • Availability for business trips in Brazil.

Vaga para desenvolvimento frontend com foco em interfaces web para produtos digitais, integração com APIs complexas, dados em tempo real e visualização de grandes volumes de dados.


Atuação em aplicações que envolvem WebSockets, mapas, geolocalização e camadas GIS, interfaces operacionais 24/7, controle de acesso por perfil e restrições de latência e performance em sistemas críticos e orientados a funcionamento contínuo.

title: Application Developer - PL
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter aplicativos web e sistemas de software de acordo com as necessidades do negócio;
  • Analisar requisitos, projetar soluções, escrever código, realizar testes e fazer a implantação de novos recursos e funcionalidades;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para resolver problemas, melhorar a qualidade do código e a eficiência dos processos;
  • Participar de reuniões e workshops para entender as demandas dos clientes e stakeholders.
  • Documentar o desenvolvimento e as atualizações realizadas nos sistemas;
  • Suportar e resolver incidentes relacionados aos aplicativos em produção.


Requisitos:


  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos como desenvolvedor de aplicativos web;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em linguagens de programação como Java, JavaScript, entre outras;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks e bibliotecas como Spring, Angular, etc;
  • Habilidades em desenvolvimento back-end e front-end;
  • Experiência em bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, como Scrum;
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade de trabalho em equipe e habilidades de resolução de problemas.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência em arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Conhecimento em DevOps e ferramentas de CI/CD.



Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic & Video Content Designer

We are building a fast-growing brand in the health and wellness industry and are seeking a strategic, creative, and performance-driven Graphic & Video Content Designer.

This is a key position within the company, with direct impact on sales performance, brand positioning, and overall growth. If you thrive in a dynamic environment, can manage a high volume of projects, and enjoy taking creative ownership, this opportunity is for you.

Responsibilities

• Create high-impact graphic and video content for paid ads, social media, email marketing, website, and online marketplaces

• Develop creative concepts aligned with marketing strategy and conversion objectives

• Produce short-form videos optimized for TikTok, Instagram, Meta Ads, and Amazon

• Prepare and finalize print-ready files for production, ensuring proper bleed, safety margins, color profiles, and print specifications

• Develop technical files for packaging, labels, and promotional materials

• Conduct quality control checks before production

• Maintain brand consistency across all platforms

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines with strong organization and attention to detail

Requirements

• Minimum of 3 years of proven experience in Graphic Design and/or Video Editing

• Hands-on experience preparing print-ready files and packaging materials

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite

• Proven experience with CorelDRAW

• Strong understanding of color profiles, CMYK, RGB, resolution, and print production standards

• Strong portfolio showcasing real projects, preferably performance-driven and e-commerce focused

• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

• High level of organization and attention to detail

Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred, but portfolio quality and proven experience carry greater weight.

What We Offer

• Opportunity to grow within a fast-expanding brand

• Dynamic and challenging work environment

• Strategic projects with direct business impact

• Competitive compensation based on experience

Application Requirements

Mandatory: Please include a portfolio link showcasing both graphic and video projects. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

In addition, please include your expected monthly compensation for the services to be provided.

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

title: Sr DevOps Engineer Azure (Remoto | PJ)
description:
100% Remote

USA Timezone

Contractor / PJ position



Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure
  • Develop automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and increase consistency.
  • Configure and optimize cloud infrastructure to align with security, scalability, and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to remove deployment blockers and improve delivery workflows.

  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .

  • Observability using Application Insights, Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, and Prometheus for metrics, logs, and traces.

Plus

  • Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS

title: Lead Engineer (JAVA)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.


Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.


Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).



What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.



Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. description:

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.

  • Versionamento e Gestão de Código: Git, GitOps.

  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).

title: Mid/Senior Devops
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join a strategic cloud migration initiative, transitioning workloads from Azure to AWS within a structured modernization program.

This professional will play a key role in supporting the technical execution of the migration, ensuring infrastructure standardization, automation, CI/CD pipeline implementation, environment readiness, observability, and post-migration operational validation.


The project follows a Lift & Shift / Replatform approach, covering infrastructure preparation, security, networking, service equivalency mapping, migration execution, testing, stabilization, and post-cutover operational readiness.


Key Responsibilities


  • Prepare and standardize AWS environments (VPC, IAM, networking, security, logging).
  • Support migrations using AWS MGN, DMS, and SCT.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
  • Implement monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, X-Ray, Grafana).
  • Validate application, database, and network functionality post-migration.
  • Support performance, scalability, and security testing.
  • Contribute to documentation and runbooks.


What do you need to know?


  • Cloud & Migration: AWS (EC2, EKS/ECS, S3, Aurora, VPC, ALB/NLB, Route 53, IAM, KMS), Azure (VMs, AKS, SQL, App Services)
  • DevOps & Automation: Terraform, Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps), Python/Bash/PowerShell
  • Migration Tools: AWS MGN, DMS, SCT
  • Integrations & Monitoring: Kafka, Snowflake, Elasticsearch, Datadog
  • Language: Fluent English


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the AI/R Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Account Manager
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
  • Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
  • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
  • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
  • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
  • Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates


This is not a passive customer success role.

It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.


You’ll likely do well here if you:

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
  • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
  • Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
  • Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
  • Take feedback well and apply it
  • Have strong written and spoken English skills
  • Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results


What you’ll get:

  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 5 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You

  • You’re a full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 3+ years of experience.
  • You’re a product-minded engineer with a pragmatic approach to building software.
  • You write expressive readable and maintainable code instead of just hacking together something that only works.
  • You’re curious about IoT, WiFi and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
  • You want to learn how a business operates and get exposure beyond just writing code.


About the Role

  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Javascript and deploy it via Heroku.
  • Work with the CTO to break down large projects into small shippable slices and execute on those projects.
  • Build API integrations with 3rd party software providers
  • Create intelligent scripts and integrations to automate WiFi management tasks
  • Create and review pull requests in Github.


Why Work at StayFi?

  • You’ll be working directly with the CTO and CEO on mission critical projects.
  • You’ll get mentorship directly from the CTO and senior engineers who can help you go from being a junior or mid-level engineer to being a true master.
  • As you continue to do good work and help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to learn the ins and outs of running a sustainable and growing business.
  • You’ll be working on a small team, so you’ll get the chance to have a large impact within our company and in the vacation rental industry at large.


Location

  • Join our fully remote team from anywhere in the world. We hire globally and currently have a strong presence in the US, Latin America (Argentina, Brazil, Colombia), Europe (Netherlands, Portugal, Romania), and Africa (Egypt, Nigeria). We are looking for the best talent, regardless of geography.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
JDA WMS Developer

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior JDA Warehouse Management System (WMS) Solution Architect to lead end to end solution design, integration, and delivery for global transformational programs. This role requires deep functional and technical expertise in JDA WMS (Discrete), exceptional communication skills, and the ability to operate in fast paced, multi vendor environments.

You will act as the primary JDA WMS expert across strategic initiatives, driving architecture, process optimization, integration design, and overall solution governance.

Desired Skills & Experience

• Bachelor’s or higher degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or Logistics.

• Strong hands-on experience with JDA Warehouse Management System (Discrete).

• Participation in 2–3 full end to end implementation projects.

• Strong domain knowledge of JDA WMS configuration, design, and delivery to support customer business processes.

• Extensive experience designing current and future-state architecture for enterprise clients.

• Deep expertise in:

o MOCA Components

o MTF

o DDA/Page Builder

o Reports & Labels

• Strong experience integrating JDA WMS with multiple host/destination systems using JDA Integrator/Connect.

• Hands-on experience with WCS, TMS, and Parcel integrations (any).

• Experience developing/modifying interfaces, tracing, debugging, and troubleshooting.

• Experience using support tools, project management tools, and global SharePoint.

• Knowledge of middleware integration methods (JDA Connect, MuleSoft, TIBCO).

• Solid understanding of SDLC, requirement analysis, and solution design.

• Experience working in dynamic, fast-paced, multi-vendor environments.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong positive attitude, ownership mindset, and focus on process improvement.

Key Responsibilities

• Actively participate in Solution Design workshops and lead end-to-end solution architecture discussions.

• Approve solution designs and validate the configured JDA WMS solution.

• Validate test concepts, test scenarios, and user acceptance criteria.

• Serve as the primary JDA WMS expert for global transformation projects and programs.

• Lead Change Management activities for global or regional implementations.

• Contribute to the Global Technology Strategy and present technical assessments to governance boards for rapid decision-making.

• Prepare and deliver presentations to users, management, and executive-level audiences.

• Advise customers on industry best practices and process methodology.

• Demonstrate and facilitate design, development, and integration discussions covering product functionality and architecture.

• Ensure smooth integration between technical and functional requirements across JDA modules.

• Proactively identify process improvement opportunities and ensure alignment with business stakeholders.

• Collaborate with Business, Service Delivery, and Service Providers in evaluating and approving new solutions.

• Drive improvements in global technology processes and service delivery.

• Translate business requirements into technical specifications and functional designs.

• Lead business process analysis, design, construction, validation, and deployment phases.

Required Qualifications

• CCNP Certification (Required)

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related field.

• Advanced English


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.
